desc: Spud the rig @ 00:00, 20-Dec-2022, Held PJSM, Perform Magnet trip. Tag ground @ 16m. P/U & M/U 26" R.Bit (#1, Used, ReedHycalog, 111, 3 x 18/32" Nz + C.J  18/32", SN: HA7493), RIH w/ 9-3/4" B.Sub (Float valve & Bafle plate in) + 2 Jt 9-3/4" DC + XOS, followed by 1 JT 5" DP to 16m.
Comm. Drlg 26" hole section f/ 16 to 29m w/ NL. DRLG Parameters: 2-8 Klbs, 15-70 RPM, F.R.: 100-300 GPM, SPP: 10-50 PSI, TQ: 1-2 Kft.lb,  Avg ROP: 1.3 MPH.
POOH to surface. Check bit, OBS. bit partially balled up. Clean the bit. L/D 5" DP single, & Add 2 Jts 9-3/4" DC and 1 Jt 5" DPs in BHA. RIH to BTM.
Cont. DLRG 26" H.S f/ 29 to 48m (Kelly Down) W/ NL. DRLG Parameters: 8-16 Klbs, 50-70 RPM, F.R.: 300-450 GPM, SPP: 250-400 PSI, TQ: 3-5 Kft.lb,  Avg ROP: 3 MPH.
POOH to surface. Check bit; Ok.
RIH to BTM while add 26" stabilizer (F.G) @ 20m & 1 Jt 9-3/4" DC + 1 Jt 5" DP to BHA.
Cont. DLRG 26" H.S to 60m W/ NL. DRLG Parameters: 5-25 Klbs, 70-95 RPM, F.R.: 650 GPM, SPP: 450 PSI, TQ: 2-5Kft.lb,  ROP: 12 MPH.
L/D 5" DP Single, add 2 Jt. 8-1/2" DC + 1 Jt 5" DP to BHA. *** Spud Rig 207 OEOC @ 00:00, 20-Dec-2022***
Cont. DLRG 26" H.S f/ 60 to 79m W/ NL. DRLG Parameters: 15-25 Klbs, 90 RPM, F.R.: 700-800 GPM, SPP: 550-800 PSI, 2-6 Kft.lb, ROP: 6-7 MPH.
L/D 5" DP Single, add 1 Jt. 8-1/2" DC + 1 Jt 5" DP to BHA.
Cont. DLRG 26" H.S to 152m W/ NL while add 7 jt 5" DP (Jt by Jt). DRLG Parameters: 15-20 Klbs, 70-95 RPM, F.R.: 900 GPM, SPP: 1050-1100 PSI, 2-6 Kft.lb, ROP: 6-10 MPH.
Circ. till clean shaker while reciprocate string, NL.
POOH on elevator to 20m, L/D 26" stabilizer.
RIH as condition trip to 152m while M/U 8 Jts 5" DPs W/ good hole condition.
Pump & spot 100 bbl hi-vis pill, NL.
Drop Totco @ 150m. POOH to Surface, L/D 26" R.Bit (dull: 1-1-WT-A-2-I-NO-TD). Ret. totco (Dev.: 0.5 Deg.).
R/Up 20" CSG running equipment (NIDC).

HPJSM, P/U 20" CSG Shoe Jt (106.5#, K-55, BTC) w/ welded stab in type float shoe on it, F/U Shoe Jt & Install 20" * 26" Bow Centralizer. P/U & M/U second 20" CSG Jt, F/U same, Float shoe function, OK. Cont. RIH w/ 11 Jts 20" CSG (106.5#, K-55, BTC) to 149m (20" CSG shoe) while install 20" * 26" Bow centralizer as per program.
Circ. as 1.5 Cap of 20'' CSG, NL. while R/D NIDC CSG running equipment.
M/U 5" P.Jt on 5" Stinger. Install 5" * 20" Centralizer on P.Jt, RIH w/ 5" DPs & sting in Shoe. Circ & check 20" * 5" Ann, Ok.
L/U CMT line to 5" DP. Press. test to 3000 psi for 10 min, Ok.

Pump 40 bbl f.water as spacer ahead, Mix & Pump CMT "G" Delijan (SV: 200 bbl, SW: 118 pcf) w/ 5-6 BPM & 600-700 PSI while monitor 5" * 20" Ann continuously; static. got contaminated mud after pump 150 bbl & got 118 PCF CMT slurry after pump 180 bbl in return. Displace w/ 7 bbl 63 PCF fresh water. Check back flow; Ok. Sting out, Float check; Ok. POOH to surf. & L/D stinger (Good condition) while flush C.P, B.Nipple, Flow line & Cellar. Hang up 20" CSG by elevator.
Wait on cement. (Surf samples 100 % hard after 5 hrs) while digging base of cellar to prepare enough space for welder working (amlost 10 cm around C.P).
Open window on conductor pipe, Slack off 20" CSG; no movement. Rough cut 20" CSG, L/D landing joint & Cond. Pipe.
Pre Heat 21-1/4" 2K CHH.

N/U 21-1/4" 2K CHH, Align & level same (Top cellar to top flange of CHH: 1.73m), PreHeat CHH body before welding. Off line operation: inspecting 5" DPs is in progress. CMT Service (Sarvak kish) Arrived @ 21-Dec-2022, 21:00 & Released @ 22-Dec-2022, 14:00 Rec. standby pump truck (Sarvak kish Co.) @ 22-Dec-2022, 01:30 & Released @ 22-Dec-2022, 18:00 Rec. main pump truck (Sarvak kish Co.) @ 21-Dec-2022, 21:30 & Released @ 22-Dec-2022, 18:00 Wellhead Crew (MSA) Arrived @ 21-Dec-2022, 17:00 CSG Running Crew (NIDC) Arrived @ 21 Dec-2022, 19:00  & Released @ 22-Dec-2022, 14:00
Welding 21-1/4" 2K CHH to 20'' CSG Neck form inside & out side.
Wait on cooling CHH.

Install side outlet vlave on CHH, (2 No. 2-1/16" 5K valve on each side), Set VR Plug, Perform body press test to 4500 Psi / 10 min, Ok. Press test each valves to 4500 Psi / 10 min, OK. Press test CHH to 600 Psi / 10 min; Ok

N/U 21-1/4'' 2K x 21-1/4'' 2K DSA, 21-1/4" 2K Spacer spool, 21-1/4" 2K x 21-1/4'' 2K DRLG spool, 21-1/4'' 2K Hy-Drill & Bell nipple. Install related line & valves. Connect 2" kill line & 4" choke line.  Connect hydraulic hoses of Diverter, 2" & 4" ' HCR Vlv to accumulator system.
Perform BOP Test as NIOC policy, Body test to 600 PSI; OK. function test koomey unit; Ok.

Make & rack back 5" DP stand is in progress (Totally: 20 stand) Off line operations: inspecting 5" DPs is in progress & Prepare 380 bbl 65 PCF Bent. Mud . Wellhead Crew (MSA) Arrived @ 21-Dec-2022, 17:00 & Released @ 22-Dec-2022, 10:00

Cont. make & rack back 5" DP stand is in progress (Totally: 50 stand). P/U & M/U 17-1/2" R.Bit #2 (Used, 115, Reed hycalog, 3*18/32" + 1*16/32" C.J, S/N: D153252) + 9-3/4" B.Sub (float in)& RIH W/ 5 Jts 9-3/4" DC + 3 Jts 8-1/2" DC 75m. Cont. RIH by 5" DPs to 147.5m (1.5m above 20" CSG shoe), Took weight @ this point. D/O hard CMT to 148.5m, D/O 20" CSG shoe f/ 148.5 to 149m, NL. Smooth 20" shoe depth several times. (WOB: 4-8 klb, Rot.: 40-50 RPM, F.R.: 400-450 GPM, SPP: 450-500 PSI, TQ: 0.5-2 llb.ft). Comm. DRLG 17-1/2" H.S to 180m, NL. (WOB: 4-16 klb, Rot.: 40-90 RPM, F.R.: 400-800 GPM, SPP: 450-950 PSI, TQ: 2-4 klb.ft). Circ. BTM's Up, NL. In order to change bit, POOH 17-1/2" R.Bit to 150m on elevator, Cont. POOH to surface. L/D Bit (Dul: 1-1-WT-??????

P/U & M/U 17-1/2" PDC Bit #3 (Used, NOV, 6*20/32", S/N: E169133) + 9-3/4" B.Sub (float & bafel plate in) + 1Jt 9-3/4" DC + 17-1/2" Stab. (U.G) + 1 Jt 9-3/4" DC + 17-1/2" Stab. (U.G) + 4Jts 9-3/4" DC + XOS + 6 Jts 8-1/2" DC + XOS to 116m.
Cont. RIH By 5" DPs to 149m (20" CSG shoe), Smooth this point several times. Cont. RIH as R/Dn to 180m (BTM).

Resume DRLG 17-1/2" H.S F/ 180 to 287m meanwhile ream & back ream each drilled stand while pump 30 bbl hi-vis pill to sweep hole, NL. (WOB: 4-15 klb, Rot.: 70-180 RPM, F.R.: 500-1000 GPM, SPP: 400-1350 PSI, TQ: 2-7 klb.ft, ROP: 25-30m/Hr).
Circ. BTM's Up, NL.
POOH to 116m while circ. across wellhead, NL.
Add 5 stands 5" HWDP to BHA. RIH to 253m followed By 5" DPs to 287m (BTM).
Resume DRLG 17-1/2" H.S to 435m while R & B/R each drilled stand & pump hi-vis pill periodically to sweep hole, NL.
Run totco survey @426m (Dev.: 1 Deg.) while work on mud pumps.

Cont. DRLG formation F/ 435 to 515m while R & B/R each drilled stand, NL. (WOB: 4-15 klb, Rot.: 170-180 RPM, F.R.: 950-1000 GPM, SPP: 1300-1650 PSI, TQ: 2-7 klb.ft, ROP: 25-30m/Hr). Time Break Down:      DRLG= 11 Hrs        R & B/R= 4 Hrs         Connection= 2 Hrs Off line operations: inspecting 5" DPs is in progress & Prepare 200 bbl 65 PCF Bentonite Mud.

Cont. Drlg 17-1/2" H.S f/ 515 to 795 m while R & B/R each drilled Stds & pump Hi-Vis Pill periodically to sweep hole, NL. (WOB: 6-16 klb, Rot.: 170-180 RPM, F.R.: 1000 GPM, SPP: 1650-1920 psi, TQ: 3-8 klb.ft, Av. ROP: 23.3 MPH).
Circ. BTM's Up to clean shakers while reciprocate string, NL.
R/B 1 Std & Run totco survey @ 770 m. Retrieve same; Dev.: 0.5 Deg.
Commence POOH on elevator f/ 770 to 150 m (Shoe Depth) as wiper trip w/ good hole condition while CWH; NL.
Establish Circ. Hi-Rate till MN while reciprocate string, NL. Time Break Down:      Drlg= 12 Hrs        R & B/R= 4 Hrs         Connection= 2 Hrs
Run back to 795 m (BTM) w/ good hole condition while F/U string each 10 Stds, NL.
Displace the well w/ 74 pcf Salt/Polymer mud. Over Circ to uniform MW in/out.

Resume Drlg 17-1/2" H.S f/ 795 to 1018 m till MN while B/R & R/D each drilled Std & pump Hi-Vis Pill periodically to sweep hole, NL. Due to Obs increase calcium several times in flow return, Perform dynamic flow check the well; Static. Increase MW f/ 74 to 76 pcf. (WOB: 6-16 klb, Rot.: 140-180 RPM, F.R.:800 - 1000 GPM, SPP: 880-1800 psi, TQ: 3-7 klb.ft, Av. ROP: 17 MPH). Time Break Down:      Drlg= 13 Hrs        R & B/R= 3 Hrs         Connection= 2 Hrs

Cont. Drlg 17-1/2" H.S f/ 1018  to 1028 m while R & B/R each drilled Std & pump Hi-Vis Pill periodically to sweep hole, NL. (WOB: 6-16 klb, Rot.: 180 RPM, F.R.: 1000 GPM, SPP: 1700 psi, TQ: 3-7 klb.ft, Av. ROP: 10 MPH).
Due to suspect flow, Perform dynamic flow check the well; Static.

Resume Drlg 17-1/2" H.S f/ 1028 to 1042 m, NL. During connection Obs. slightly return. while try to increase MW f/ 76 to 77 pcf. (WOB: 15-25 klb, Rot.: 180 RPM, F.R.: 1000 GPM, SPP: 1700 psi, TQ: 5-9 klb.ft, Av. ROP: 14 MPH). Time Break Down:      Drlg= 2 Hrs        R & B/R= 0.5 Hrs

Obs suddenly increase flow return, P/U string & Divert the well on CM & Circ. f/ Manual choke wide open. Increase MW to 80 pcf Meanwhile dump 300 bbl 66-70 pcf salt water in flow return. Cont. Circ. to uniform MW in/out to 80 pcf also Obs gain f/ 100 to 10 BPH.

Cont. Circ. to uniform MW in/out to 80 pcf; MW in = 78-80 pcf & Out = 74-76 pcf till MN, While Circ. f/ Manual choke & strip string every 1 Hr; Ok. Decided to Circ mud & Make 1400 bbl 90 pcf mud on surface.
Cont. Circ. mud; MW in = 80-72 pcf & Out = 76-72 pcf & Circ. f/ Manual choke & Adjust same; NL-NG. While strip string every 1 Hr; Ok. Meanwhile make 450 bbl 90 pcf mud on surface.

Cont. Circ. While flow the well thru CM (wide open). FR: 50, MW in = 69 pcf & Out =69 pcf While take flow rate the well with 600BPH gain. While strip string every 1 Hr & Make 850 bbl 90 pcf mud on surface.

Open the well & conduct flow return to waste pit , Pull out string w/ soft B/R to 950 m (2 Stds). cont. slow circulate thru string while reciprocate string & take flow rate every 2 Hrs; 550 - 600 BPH gain. FR: 100 gpm , MW in/out =69 pcf.

Commence POOH 17-1/2” Drlg BHA f/ 950 to 700 m on elevator w/ good hole condition till MN, Circ. CWH; 470 BPH Gain. While Cont. make 90 pcf mud. Check return sample @ sev. Times; (MW:69 pcf, PH: 7, CL: 116000, Ca: 500- 600) Make totally 980 bbl 90 pcf mud & 200 bbl Hi-Vis Bentonite pill on surface.

Bullhead the well w/ max 1800 psi Ann Press and pump 420 bbl while Ann Press decreased to 350 psi. Pump off (SICP: 250 psi). Open the well. RIH w/ 8-3/8" R.Bit (King Dream, Used, 214, Open) + 6-1/2" B.Sub (Float-in) + 3 Std 6-1/2" DC + 6-1/2" Drlg Jar + 1 Std 6-1/2" DC + 2 Stds 5" HWDP & 4 Stds 5" DP to 280 m w/ totally 320 bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 1150 psi in 45 min. Bullhead the well w/ max 2000 psi Ann Press and pump 500 bbl while Ann Press decreased to 450 psi. Pump off (SICP: 250 psi). Bleed off Press. Open the well. RIH to 550 m w/ totally 300 bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 940 Psi in 30 min. Bullhead the well w/ max 1100 psi Ann Press and pump 380 bbl while Ann Press decreased to 470 psi (Pump off: 330 psi). Bleed off press, Open the well. RIH to 860 m w/ totally 260 bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 800 psi in 30 min. Bullhead the well w/ max 980 psi Ann Press and pump 320 bbl while Ann Press decreased to 500 psi (Pump off: 360 psi). Bleed off press, Open the well. RIH to 1090 m w/ totally 250 bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 780 psi in 30 min. Bullhead the well w/ max 900 psi Ann Press and pump 340 bbl while Ann Press decreased to 490 psi (Pump off: 300 psi). Bleed off press, Open the well. RIH to 1460 m w/ totally 280 bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 880 psi in 30min. Bullhead the well w/ max 1000 psi Ann Press and pump 370 bbl while Ann Press decreased to 470 psi . Pump off (SICP: 350 psi). Bleed off press, Open the well. RIH 1830 m w/ totally 350 bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 1200 psi in 30 min. Bullhead the well w/ max 1400 psi Ann Press and pump 430 bbl while Ann Press decreased to 600 psi. Pump off (SICP: 380 psi). Bleed off press, Open the well. RIH to 2076 m w/ totally 340 bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 1260 psi.

Establish Circ thru string & Pump 450 bbl 149 pcf; got 142 to 118 pcf in return. Cont Circ. & Dump 400 bbl 92 to 85 pcf cut mud. Cont. Circ. & Pump totally 900 bbl get 120 pcf mud in return. While apply Ann press f/ 1400 to 200 psi w/ 4-20 BPH Loss. Pump off, SICP: 120 psi for 15 min. Strip-in f/ 2076 to 2266m (4 Stds/Hr) w/ 150 psi SICP. Took weight, Try to pass same; No succ. Bleed off press, Open the well and wash and ream to 2348m while shut the well in on each Std. Obs. string stall. Try to POOH, Obs. String stuck. Work on stuck w/ max 80 klbs. overpull; got free. POOH to 2295m w/ 20-70 klbs overpull. Due to obs. gain rate increased severely, Shut the well in (Totally 350 bbl gain). SICP increased to 1560psi after 45min. Commence killing the well w/ max 1800 to 700 psi ann press while manual and adj. choke plugged several times due to huge amount of cutting in return mud. After pumping 800 bbl, dump 400 bbl 90-82pcf f/ return. After that return MW increased f/ 110 to 122 pcf. Unplug choke manifold. Cont. Killing the well  w/ 700 to 300 Ann Press. After  totally pumping 1300 bbl w/ max 130 pcf mud 10-20 BPH Loss. Due to huge amount of cutting in return mud; Obs. both manual choke Plugged and Ann Press increased to 600 psi.

Open Ann Preventer; Obs no return. Try to establish Circ. & Try to get return w/ diff. F.R, finally got return w/ 60-80 bph loss. Soft wash & Ream Dn to 2325 m (2 Stds); while B/R Stall string @ 2320 & 2300 m. Work on same w/ max 70 Klbs overpull; got free. After that try to ream Dn; No-Succ, w/ 60-80 BPH loss. Finally Check & RIH w/o Rot to 2324 m while Check slips area several times; Ok. After disconnect TDS in order to retrieve pipe screen & Pump Hi-Vis LCM Pill; Obs. String stuck. Work on string stuck w/ max 130 Klbs overpull & Fully S/O string Wt; No-Succ. Increased gain rate sharply, while work on string stuck w/ max 100 Klbs overpull; String got free. Obs. huge amount of cuttings on shakers. Cont. flow the well to max 200 bbl gain in order to off-load & clean the well. POOH to 2257 m, check last Std; Ok. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 1000 psi while strip-in, strip-out string; Ok & pump inside string periodically in order to prevent plugging. Wt Up mud on surface to 149 pcf. Strip-Out to 2000 m, Pump & inject 150 bbl LCM Pill 30 ppb & Displace same to 20 m above 13-5/8" CSG Shoe w/ max 1200 Ann Press. Commence killing the well w/ 149 pcf mud (Totally 450 bbl); Ann Press decreased f/ 1000 to 300 psi while got 128-143 pcf in return. Obs. both manual choke plugged. Shut the well in.

Unplug choke manifold. Cont. killing the well; Obs. both manual choke plugged. Open C.M f/ 4" middle row (wide open), Cont. Circ & Pump 650 bbl Hi-Rate (500 GPM, 2700 psi) in order to off-load & clean the well (over Circ. 100 bbl) w/ 60 BPH Gain. After that Obs. amount of cutting on shakers decreased considerably (Obs. just small size of cutting on shaker). Shut the well in. SICP increased to 850 psi meanwhile overhaul hoppers.
Slip & cut Drlg line meanwhile prepare 149 pcf mud @ surface.

Commence killing the well w/ pump totally 1300 bbl (1.5 times Ann Vol) 149 pcf mud; Ann Press decreased f/ 1000 to 480 psi while got 120-145 pcf in return w/ 15-30 BPH Loss. Unable to get 149 pcf mud in return. During killing the well w/ 30 psi tolerance; Change the situation between gain & lost return. Also Obs. just small size of cutting on shakers.

Shut the well in. SICP increased to 400psi. Bleed off Press. Open the well. POOH f/ 2000 to 1625m w/ 100bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 600psi. Bullhead the well w/ max 900psi Ann Press & pump 250bbl while Ann Press decreased to 400psi (Pump off: 250psi). Bleed off Press. Open the well, POOH to 1320m w/ 150bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 600psi. Bullhead the well w/ max 830psi Ann Press & pump 250bbl while Ann Press decreased to 350psi (Pump off: 250psi). Bleed off Press. Open the well, POOH to 780m w/ 200bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 750psi. Bullhead the well w/ max 1000psi Ann Press & pump 350bbl while Ann Press decreased to 450psi (Pump off: 260psi). Bleed off Press. Open the well, POOH to 430m w/ 250bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 970psi. Bullhead the well w/ max 1100psi Ann Press & pump 320bbl while Ann Press decreased to 450psi (Pump off: 230psi). Bleed off Press. Open the well, POOH to 150 m w/ totally 270 bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 930psi. Bullhead the well w/ max 1050psi Ann Press & pump 350bbl while Ann Press decreased to 430psi (Pump off: 200psi). Bleed off Press. Open the well, POOH to 82m w/ 320bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 1350psi. Bullhead the well w/ max 1450psi Ann Press & pump 420bbl while Ann Press decreased to 430psi (Pump off: 200psi). Bleed of Press. Open the well, POOH to surface w/ 200bbl gain. Bit Dull: 1-1-WT-A-E-I-NO-BHA. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 640psi. Bullhead the well w/ max 800 psi Ann Press & pump 300bbl while Ann Press decreased to 4500psi (Pump off: 250psi) While P/U & M/U C.Cut + 6-1/2" B.Sub (Float in) on 5" DP. Bleed off Press. Open the well, RIH w/ C.Cut + 6-1/2" B.Sub (Float in) & 7 Stds 5" DP to 190m w/ totally 200bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 800 psi till M.N. Note: 1- Urgent Mud Material Shortage: Barite, Ferro bar, Salt (Current stock: Barite: 120, Ferro bar: 12 MT, Salt: 90 MT). 2- 20" x 13-3/8" Ann Press: Zero.

Bullhead the well w/ max 800psi Ann Press & pump 230bbl while Ann Press decreased to 430psi (Pump off: 200psi). Bleed of Press. Open the well, Resume RIH w/ 8-3/8" C.Cut f/ 190 to 330m w/ 200bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 900psi. Bullhead the well w/ max 1000psi Ann Press & pump 250bbl while Ann Press decreased to 450psi (Pump off: 250psi). Bleed of Press. Open the well, Resume RIH to 540m w/ 300bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 1100psi. Bullhead the well w/ max 1200psi Ann Press & pump 350bbl while Ann Press decreased to 450psi (Pump off: 250psi). Bleed of Press. Open the well, Resume RIH to 745m w/ 300bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 1300psi. Bullhead the well w/ max 1400psi Ann Press & pump 370bbl while Ann Press decreased to 480psi (Pump off: 300psi). Bleed of Press. Open the well, Resume RIH to 1230m w/ 280bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 1000psi. Bullhead the well w/ max 1100psi Ann Press & pump 400bbl while Ann Press decreased to 460psi (Pump off: 310psi). Bleed of Press. Open the well, Resume RIH to 1518m w/ 260bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 840psi. Bullhead the well w/ max 900psi Ann Press & pump 300bbl while Ann Press decreased to 480psi (Pump off: 315psi). Bleed of Press. Open the well, Resume RIH to 1776m w/ 280bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 900psi. Bullhead the well w/ max 1000psi Ann Press & pump 350bbl while Ann Press decreased to 570psi (Pump off: 390psi). Bleed of Press. Open the well, Resume RIH to 1891m w/ 190bbl gain. Shut the well in. SICP increased to 770psi. Bullhead the well as injectivity test w/ 50bbl (3-4BPM, 700-800psi).

L/U CMT line to string. Press test to 500/4000 psi; OK meanwhile prepare CMT solution. Pump 10bbl fresh water as spacer ahead. Mix and pump 638sxs CMT "G" Delijan (S.V: 150 bbl. S.W: 125pcf) meanwhile reciprocate string. Note: 1- Urgent Mud Material Shortage: Barite, Ferro bar, Salt (Current stock: Barite: 100 MT, Ferro bar: 12 MT, Salt: 85 MT). 2- 20" x 13-3/8" Ann Press: Zero.

Pump 5bbl fresh water as spacer behind. Displace and inject CMT w/ 155bbl 149 pcf mud (max pumping Press: 2500psi, 3BPM, Max Ann. Press: 1000psi) Cont. injecting CMT w/ pumping 18bbl mud f/ Ann meanwhile reciprocate string.
WOC to get hard meanwhile reciprocate string & monitor well press; 1100psi. Surface CMT sample 100% hard after 24Hrs.
Cont. WOC to get hard meanwhile reciprocate string & monitor well press; 1100psi.
Bleed off Press to zero. Open the well; Static. RIH f/ 1889 to 2021m. Tag TOC. Try to Wash Dn; No-Succ. CBU & Uniform MW to 149 pcf; NL-NG while reciprocate string.
Perform static flow check the well; NL-NG.
Wait on client to make decision for next operation meanwhile slow Circ. Thru string w/ NL-NG till M.N.
Cont. Wait on client to make decision for next operation meanwhile slow Circ. Thru string w/ NL-NG till M.N
Cont. Wait on client to make decision for next operation meanwhile slow Circ. Thru string w/ NL-NG till MN.
Cont. POOH 17-1/2” Drlg BHA f/ 700 to 149 m (20" CSG Shoe) on elevator w/ good hole condition, Circ. CWH; 450-600 BPH Gain.

Cont. POOH 17-1/2” Drlg BHA f/ 149 m to surface; 450-600 BPH Gain. L/D 17-1/2" PDC Bit (Dull: 2-1-CT-N-X-I-WT-BHA), While Cont. make 90 pcf mud. Check return sample @ sev. Times; (MW:69 pcf, PH: 7, CL: 116000, Ca: 500- 600)

P/U & M/U 8-3/8" Center Cut Bit + 6-1/2" B.Sub (Float in) & Followed by 5" DPs to 1000 m (1 Std Off-BTM), F/U string every 10 stds. Meanwhile Cont. Circ. & Flow the well thru CM (Wide open) & Flow line to waste pit; 470 - 670 BPH Gain. Make totally 1300 bbl 90 pcf mud & 400 bbl Bentonite pill w/ 40 PPB LCM on surface.

Pump 400 bbl Bentonite LCM Pill (40 PPB) & 900 bbl 90 pcf mud while add 15 PPB LCM to active system. After totally pumped 1200 bbl got 74 pcf mud in return; Conduct return to mud pits & Check pit level carefully; 4-6 BPH Gain.
Cont. Circ. mud while increase MW to 92-93 pcf w/ 0-8 BPH Gain. Meanwhile reciprocate string.

Cont. Circ. mud & try to increase MW to 96 pcf; No-Succ w/ 0-8 BPH Gain. Due to failure of mud hoppers several times. MW in=92-90 pcf , out = 92-89 pcf. *** 5 Hrs NPT Considered for OEOC (Rig Contractor) Due to failure of mud hoppers several times which lead to delay in operation. *** 24 Hrs open the well & conduct flow return to waste pit; 500-600 BPH Gain. Flow Result: MW:69 pcf, PH: 7, CL: 116000, Ca: 500- 600 *** Before open the well; Obs several seepage around the well site location @ several points. During open the well & secure same w/ 90 pcf LCM mud; Obs seepages gradually interrupted. Off line operations: inspecting 5" & 3.5" DPs is in progress.

Cont. Circ. mud w/ 0-8 BPH Gain while make 150 bbl 130 pcf kill mud; add to active mud system. Cont. Circ mud till MW in/out balanced to 96 pcf; NL-NG. Decrease F.R f/ 1000 to 400 GPM & Check pit level; NL-NG. While work on mud properties.
